definitions.gloss: formation, origin, how something came to be
definitions.explanation: The process or history by which something was formed or established. Often used when explaining how a word, organization, or concept originated.
The way something is composed or made up of its constituent parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked up the origin of this kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain how the company was established.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{中国語|ちゅうごくご}→中国語：10966_chuugokugo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Chinese influence played a large role in the formation of the Japanese language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the makeup of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The composition of Earth's atmosphere is complex.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}すれば→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧くる。
examples.english: If you understand the structure of this organization, the cause of the problem becomes clear.

notes:
{成|な}り{立|た}ち is the noun form derived from the verb ⟦{成|な}り{立|た}つ→成り立つ：07921_naritatsu⟧ (to be established, to consist of). It refers to either how something came into being or what something is made up of.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち: origin of a kanji
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち: etymology of a word
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成|な}り{立|た}ち: makeup of society

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧: origin, derivation
- ⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧: composition, structure
